observations: Stainless steel industrial food chopper or processor.
Control panel features an ON/OFF toggle switch, a START button, and a large red STOP emergency button.
The text 'FOOD CHOPPER' and model 'WJ-R07 PLUS' are printed on the front panel.
The machine has a large stainless steel bowl with two side handles and locking latches.
The item is resting on a wooden pallet in an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
A watermark 'OBITEX COMMERCIAL KITCHEN' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The heavy-duty stainless steel construction and industrial-style control buttons in photo 0 support this.
The text 'FOOD CHOPPER' is clearly visible on the unit in photo 0.
The model number WJ-R07 often corresponds to a 7-liter capacity, but no capacity markings are visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and the blades spinning.

risks.risk: The internal blades may be missing, chipped, or severely dulled.
risks.proof: A photo of the inside of the bowl showing the blade assembly.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full blade replacement

risks.risk: The bowl seal may leak during operation.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running with water inside the bowl.

risks.risk: Electrical wiring may be damaged or unsafe.
risks.proof: A photo of the power cord, plug, and the manufacturer's rating plate on the back/side.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running to confirm the motor and switches work.
Photo of the inside of the bowl to inspect the blades.
Photo of the technical specification plate (usually on the back) to confirm voltage and wattage.
response.reason: The model number WJ-R07 PLUS is clearly visible, allowing for a valuation based on known specifications for this industrial unit, priced at its worst case due to lack of functional proof.
